links.comparator_used: Unassisted manual pathologist reads (no AI assistance)
links.outcome: Accuracy of MASH histology scoring (inflammation, ballooning, MAS ≥ 4 with ≥1 in each category, MASH resolution, steatosis, fibrosis) and inter-reader variability
links.effect: AIM-MASH-assisted reads were superior to unassisted reads for inflammation, ballooning, MAS ≥ 4 with ≥1 in each score category and MASH resolution, non-inferior for steatosis and fibrosis, and decreased inter-reader variability. No numeric values given in the text.
links.quote: AIM-MASH-assisted reads by expert MASH pathologists were superior to unassisted reads in accurately assessing inflammation, ballooning, MAS ≥ 4 with ≥1 in each score category and MASH resolution, while maintaining non-inferiority in steatosis and fibrosis assessment.

design_hint: AI-assisted pathologist review versus unassisted reads
